name: Five-pack science from plates · 30/min · substations

admission.note: The bulk-inserter unlock itself grants +1 capacity in installed 2.1.24; two items per hand, with no later capacity upgrades.

baseLabCapacity.assumption: One of each RGBYP pack per research unit; no modules or research-speed bonuses

recommendations: Copper demand is 2370/min against 1800/min on a full two-lane red belt.
Provide at least 2844/min copper capacity (20% above demand); use 2 red belts or equivalent faster transport with balanced lanes.
Use the recommended machine counts for 20% nominal capacity above demand; check inserters and shared intermediate belts separately.
